Deploy preview for *algolia-instantsearch* ready!

Built with commit 807207dc8ee8611258e4fdf8e33df6a4f5d5fe66

https://deploy-preview-2900--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com
Thanks for contributing! Behaviour can be tried out here: https://deploy-preview-2900--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com/v2/dev-novel/?selectedStory=RangeSlider.default

If I use the scenario of the #2404 in https://deploy-preview-2900--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com/v2/dev-novel/?selectedStory=RangeSlider.default
 - initial search: no bounds
 - set min bound to 1500 (around): min bound = 1500
 - type I: query = I, min bound = 1500
 - type K: query = IK, min bound = 180
 - remove one character: query = I, min bound = 180

We can see that this does not solve #2404

I think with this scenario we get
* initial search: no bounds
* set min bound to 1500 (around): min bound = 1500
* type I: query = I, min bound = 1500
* type K: query = IK, min bound = 12
* remove one character: query = I, min bound = 1

it's not what expected
Thanks for the initiative @rezak-otmani. We'll need more time and research to know what exact behavior we want to achieve regarding this issue.

title: fix(RangeSlider): go back to original bounds in case of an overflow
